Results.ReviewText:
This is my first Natural gas grill so I have nothing but LP grill to compare.  I like the grill it does cook differently than my 17 year old lp grill but that might be suspected.  There are still some hot spots.
Please note that I did not assemble this grill my self and did not see a parts list.
My biggest concern is that it is more difficult to light, the one, facing the grill, left burner.  I will address this soon.  the other concern is that the front legs, or legs without the wheels seem flimsy and offer no protection for the floor and may bend if not moved carefully.  I wish there were wheels with locks on all four wheels.   
It is still a weber and I have used Weber gas grills for 40 years they are great grills with lots options for parts and rebuilds.
Results.Title: OK but
